# blazor-dashboard-kit

Render accessible SVG charts and HTML tables with WCAG 2.2 contrast checks and dataset filtering.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Installation, usage, and API summary.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Rendering and calculation logic.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Test suite coverage.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model and resource limits.
